## Governing Overview

[Owning route overview](../../overview.md)

## Purpose

Retain the largest knowledge_diff answer-table sample as a static transport-shape witness.

## Code Commentary

The literal comparison contains tree/revision identities, kind counts and decision-ordered record names plus a caller-readable report path. Git rename detection can make physical change categories differ from the authored corpus scenario; stored counts are read as produced, not normalized to prose expectations.

The answer-table tests consume these exact fixture bytes. Production versus recorded provenance and regeneration belong to PROVENANCE.md and the test producer, not manual edits of identities, tokens or output counts. No secret or current operational credential is represented by these static values.
